sentences.text: Chocolates save us from many things, especially emotional distress.

analysis.translationLiteral: 巧克力把我们从许多东西中拯救出来，尤其是情绪上的苦闷。

phrases.meaning: 巧克力（可数/不可数）（chocolate 的复数/三单形式）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：chocolates（复数/三单）/ chocolate（原形）。

phrases.usage: 注意区分：things（事情/东西）/ stuff（东西，不可数，口语）。常见搭配：all things considered / the thing is。

注意区分：things（事情/东西）/ stuff（东西，不可数，口语）。

analysis.structMarkup: 【They】 _comfort us_ (in times of trouble), (calming down a racing heart) (by channelling happy calories inside us).

及物动词 + 宾语

clauses: 逗号后的现在分词短语作伴随状语或补充说明，逻辑主语与主句主语一致。

paragraphs.text: Recently, chocolate lovers were heartbroken as scientists claimed that they can become extinct by 2050! But hey, we have some happy news for you. sentences.text: Recently, chocolate lovers were heartbroken as scientists claimed that they can become extinct by 2050!

analysis.translationLiteral: 最近，巧克力爱好者们心碎了，因为科学家声称它们到 2050 年可能灭绝！
analysis.translationNatural: 前阵子巧克力控们可炸了锅：科学家说，到 2050 年巧克力说不定就没了。
analysis.structMarkup: (Recently), 【chocolate lovers】 _were heartbroken_ {as scientists claimed that they can become extinct by 2050}!
analysis.structureSummary: 主系表 + 原因状语从句（as 引导，含宾语从句 that 引导）

components.note: 时间状语，引出「新近的坏消息」
复数，系动词用 were
系表结构；heartbroken 由「心碎」引申为「大为难过」

components.part: as scientists claimed that they can become extinct by 2050
components.note: as 表原因；claimed 后接 that 宾语从句，they 回指 chocolates，by 2050 意为「到……之前」

clauses: 状语从句「as scientists claimed that they can become extinct by 2050」：as 表原因；claimed 后接 that 宾语从句，they 回指 chocolates，by 2050 意为「到……之前」
be + 过去分词构成被动语态，主语是动作的承受者。

phrases.meaning: 最近的、近来的（recent 的副词形式）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：recently（副词）/ recent（原形）。
phrases.example: Recently, chocolate lovers were heartbroken as scientists claimed that they can become extinct by 2050! 前阵子巧克力控们可炸了锅：科学家说，到 2050 年巧克力说不定就没了。

phrases.usage: 注意区分：chocolate（不可数泛指）/ chocolates（一盒块装巧克力）。常见搭配：a bar of chocolate / dark chocolate。
phrases.example: She treats herself to chocolate sometimes. 她偶尔吃点巧克力犒劳自己。

phrases.usage: 注意区分：scientist（科学家）/ science（科学）。常见搭配：social scientists / scientists found。
phrases.example: Social scientists found digital use beneficial. 社会科学家发现数字使用有益。

pitfalls: 被动语态的过去分词不能误写成过去式；不及物动词没有被动。
注意区分：recently（副词）/ recent（原形）。
注意区分：chocolate（不可数泛指）/ chocolates（一盒块装巧克力）。
analysis.paragraphRole: 抛出「2050 年前巧克力可能消失」这一断言，是第 52 题 D 项 unavailable in less than 30 years 的出处。

sentences.text: But hey, we have some happy news for you.

analysis.translationLiteral: 但是嘿，我们有一些好消息给你。
analysis.translationNatural: 不过别急，这儿有个好消息。

components.note: But 转折 + hey 呼语，口语化地把坏消息刹住
作者以第一人称直接对读者说话
及物动词
news 不可数，用 some 修饰；happy 与上文 heartbroken 反义对照
介词短语点明消息给谁

clauses: 本句是简单句，没有从句；主干为「主谓宾 + 呼语插入」。

phrases.usage: 注意区分：news（不可数，谓语单数）/ a news（错误）/ a piece of news（正确）。常见搭配：good news / a piece of news。
phrases.example: There is some good news on this front. 这方面有好消息。

phrases.meaning: 快乐的、幸福的；满意的、乐意的（be happy with/about；happy to do 乐意做）
phrases.usage: 本句中作adj.，可按「主谓宾 + 呼语插入」定位它在句中的位置。
phrases.example: But hey, we have some happy news for you. 不过别急，这儿有个好消息。

pitfalls: 注意区分：news（不可数，谓语单数）/ a news（错误）/ a piece of news（正确）。
本句主干为「主谓宾 + 呼语插入」，读长句时先锁定限定动词再找修饰成分。
analysis.paragraphRole: 用一句口语转折从「坏消息」翻到「还有救」，为下文科学家出手做过渡。

sentences.text: Scientists can still help save chocolates from dying out!

analysis.translationNatural: 科学家还能把巧克力从「消失」边缘拉回来呢。
analysis.structMarkup: 【Scientists】 _can still help_ (save chocolates from dying out)!

components.note: 复数，情态动词用 can
情态动词 + 副词 still，强调「坏消息之后仍有办法」
help (to) save 中 to 省略；save...from doing 意为「使……免于……」

clauses: 本句是简单句，没有从句；主干为「主谓 + 不定式（不带 to）作宾补 + 介词短语」。

phrases.usage: 注意区分：scientist（科学家）/ science（科学）。常见搭配：social scientists / scientists found。
phrases.example: Social scientists found digital use beneficial. 社会科学家发现数字使用有益。

phrases.meaning: 帮助（help sb do sth / help with）；帮助（不可数）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：help sb do/to do（不带 doing）/ can't help doing（忍不住）。常见搭配：help sb do sth / help with。
phrases.example: Instincts can help you decide fast. 直觉能帮你快速决定。

phrases.meaning: 巧克力（可数/不可数）（chocolate 的复数/三单形式）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：chocolates（复数/三单）/ chocolate（原形）。
phrases.example: Scientists can still help save chocolates from dying out! 科学家还能把巧克力从「消失」边缘拉回来呢。

注意区分：still（仍然）/ yet（尚，多用于否定疑问）/ already（已经）。
注意区分：help sb do/to do（不带 doing）/ can't help doing（忍不住）。
analysis.paragraphRole: 亮出全文主线「科学家出手相救」，把话题从情绪价值转到可可树的生存危机。

sentences.text: If you are not aware as to why scientists made the statement about the death of this wonderful thing, let us tell you the facts.

analysis.translationLiteral: 如果你还不清楚科学家为何作出关于这美好东西消亡的声明，就让我们把事实告诉你。
analysis.translationNatural: 要是你没搞明白科学家凭什么这么说，下面就把原委讲清楚。

components.part: If you are not aware as to why scientists made the statement about the death of this wonderful thing
components.note: If 引导条件；be aware as to... 后接 why 引导的宾语从句；the death of 回指上句 extinct
let 型祈使句，主语 you 省略
let 的宾语
不带 to 的不定式作宾补；tell sb sth 为双宾语结构

clauses: 状语从句「If you are not aware as to why scientists made the statement about the」：If 引导条件；be aware as to... 后接 why 引导的宾语从句；the death of 回指上句 extinct

phrases.usage: 注意区分：scientist（科学家）/ science（科学）。常见搭配：social scientists / scientists found。
phrases.example: Social scientists found digital use beneficial. 社会科学家发现数字使用有益。

phrases.meaning: 做、制造；使得、使成为；获得（make 的过去式/过去分词）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：be made of（由…制成，看得出原料）/ be made from（由…制成，看不出原料）/ be made in（产地）/ be made to do（被迫做，被动须加 to）/ make sb do（主动使役不带 to）/ make（make-made-made）。
phrases.example: If you are not aware as to why scientists made the statement about the death of this wonderful thing, let us tell you the facts. 要是你没搞明白科学家凭什么这么说，下面就把原委讲清楚。

phrases.usage: 注意区分：death（死亡）/ dead（死的）/ die（死，动词）。常见搭配：the death of / to death。

注意区分：scientist（科学家）/ science（科学）。
注意区分：be made of（由…制成，看得出原料）/ be made from（由…制成，看不出原料）/ be made in（产地）/ be made to do（被迫做，被动须加 to）/ make sb do（主动使役不带 to）/ make（make-made-made）。

sentences.text: Chocolate trees, whose seeds are used to make chocolate, grow in the tropical plant world and require very specific weather conditions to prosper.

analysis.translationLiteral: 巧克力树——它们的种子被用来制作巧克力——生长在热带植物世界，并且需要非常特定的天气条件才能繁盛。

analysis.structMarkup: 【Chocolate trees】, {whose seeds are used to make chocolate}, _grow in the tropical plant world_ _and require very specific weather conditions_ (to prosper).
analysis.structureSummary: 主谓 + and 并列谓语 + 非限制性定语从句（whose 引导）

components.note: 复数，谓语用原形 grow / require

components.part: whose seeds are used to make chocolate

不定式作结果／目的，说明需要这些条件是为了「长得旺」

phrases.meaning: use 的过去式/过去分词；（be used to）习惯于；（used to）过去常常
phrases.usage: 注意区分：used to do（过去常常）/ be used to doing（习惯于）/ be used to do（被用来做）。常见搭配：used to do / be used to doing。

paragraphs.text: Now, fifty percent of the world's cocoa(可可) beans come from two countries in West Africa: Côte d'Ivoire and Ghana. Scientists believe that both of these countries will experience a 3.8°F temperature increase by 2050 due to global warming, endangering the cacao(可可树) farms in the rainforests. These farms will then have to be shifted to cooler mountainous areas, which are the natural habitat of wildlife. This will lead to some tough decisions: whether to grow chocolate or save wildlife.

questions.stem: What do people believe chocolates can do?

options.text: Cheer them up instantly.
Create happy calories.
Conceal emotional distress.
Relieve them of heart trouble.

questions.stem: What was scientists' recent assertion about chocolates?

options.text: They could become a rare treat in the near future.
They could calm people down a bit in times of crisis.
They could prevent people from getting heartbroken.
They could become unavailable in less than 30 years.

questions.stem: What would happen if the cacao farms were shifted to cooler mountainous areas?

options.text: The natural habitat of wildlife there would be ruined.
The cacao farmers would have a tough time to adapt.
The rainforests would be shrinking dramatically.
The quality of cocoa beans would suffer greatly.

questions.stem: What do we learn about the cacao farms in the crisis of global warming?

options.text: They try to seek help from gene-editing scientists.
They decide to move to cooler mountainous areas.
They have suffered a lot due to a decrease in produce.
They have benefited by raising prices of cocoa beans.

questions.stem: What are scientists trying to do in the University of California's new bio-sciences building?

options.text: Build rows of refrigerated greenhouses for research on cacao seedlings.
Gene-edit cacao seedlings for them to withstand a drier, warmer climate.
Produce chocolates with the latest gene-editing technology.
Transplant the genes of tougher plants to cacao seedlings.

more.confusables: already（已经）/ yet（尚，否定疑问）/ all ready（全都准备好）

more.confusables: areas（复数）/ area（单数）

aware.sense: 意识到的、知道的（be aware of / be aware that；本文 Almost everyone is aware of this 几乎人人都知道这一点）
examples: If you are not aware as to why scientists made the statement about the death of this wonderful thing, let us tell you the facts. 要是你没搞明白科学家凭什么这么说，下面就把原委讲清楚。

more.confusables: become（变得/成为）/ get（变得，口语）/ turn（变成，强调转变结果）

examples: I believe he is right. 我认为他是对的。

building.sense: 建筑物、房屋；建造、建筑（build 的现在分词）

business.sense: 生意、商业（不可数）；公司（可数）；事、分内事

more.confusables: business（生意）/ busy（忙的）

c.sense: 字母 C；文中作摄氏度（℃）或词库选项编号

more.confusables: C（字母/摄氏）/ see（看见）同音

called.sense: 把…叫作、称作；打电话给；召唤、召开（call 的过去式/过去分词）
examples: According to a report by The Business Insider, in the University of California's new bio-sciences building, tiny green cacao seedlings are lined up in refrigerated greenhouses for a new experiment by using a technology called CRISPR. 据《商业内幕》报道，加州大学新生物楼里，一排排绿色可可幼苗待在冷藏温室，等着用 CRISPR 技术做实验。

more.confusables: called / call（同族不同词形，注意词性与用法）

calming.sense: 使人平静的、镇静的、舒缓的；使平静（calm 的现在分词；a calming effect 镇静作用）

more.confusables: calorie（卡路里）/ calory（错误拼写）

changes.sense: 变化（change 的复数）；change 的第三人称单数

more.confusables: changes（复数/三单）/ change（单数）

examples: They comfort us in times of trouble, calming down a racing heart by channelling happy calories inside us. 难受时吃一口，就像把「快乐热量」灌进身子，扑通扑通的心也跟着安稳了。

cheaper.sense: 更便宜的、更廉价的（cheap 的比较级）
examples: By manipulating the DNA of plants, this technology is already being used across the world to make plants tougher and cheaper. 这套技术靠改动植物 DNA，如今已在各地铺开，让作物更皮实、成本更低。
She treats herself to chocolate sometimes. 她偶尔吃点巧克力犒劳自己。

more.confusables: chocolate（不可数泛指）/ chocolates（一盒块装巧克力）

chocolates.sense: 巧克力（可数/不可数）（chocolate 的复数/三单形式）
examples: Chocolates save us from many things, especially emotional distress. 巧克力能帮人挡掉不少烦心事，particularly 心里难受的时候。

more.confusables: chocolates（复数/三单）/ chocolate（原形）

claimed.sense: 声称、宣称、断言；索取、认领、索赔；说法、主张（本文 scientists claimed that chocolates can become extinct 科学家声称巧克力将消失）（claim 的过去式/过去分词形式）
examples: Recently, chocolate lovers were heartbroken as scientists claimed that they can become extinct by 2050! 前阵子巧克力控们可炸了锅：科学家说，到 2050 年巧克力说不定就没了。

more.confusables: claimed（过去式/过去分词）/ claim（原形）

examples: Climate change threatens food supply. 气候变化威胁粮食供应。

more.confusables: climate（气候，长期）/ weather（天气，短期）

climates.sense: 气候；氛围、风气（climate 的复数/三单形式）
examples: Similarly, in this unconventional experiment, scientists will make tiny, precise changes to the DNA of the seedlings to make the cocoa crops survive in warmer and drier climates. 同样地，这次非常规实验里，科学家要精准微调幼苗的 DNA，好让可可扛过又暖又干的气候。

more.confusables: climates（复数/三单）/ climate（原形）

more.confusables: cocoa（可可）/ cacao（可可树/豆）

more.confusables: come（来）/ go（去）

comfort.sense: 舒适、安逸；安慰、慰藉；安慰、使舒适

more.confusables: comfort / comfortably（同族不同词形，注意词性与用法）

conditions.sense: 条件；状况、病症（condition 的复数）

more.confusables: condition（状况/病症）/ situation（情形）/ state（状态）

cooler.sense: 更凉的、更冷的（cool 的比较级）；冷却器、冷藏箱、冰袋
examples: These farms will then have to be shifted to cooler mountainous areas, which are the natural habitat of wildlife. 到时可可园只能往更凉的山上搬，可那些山正是野生动物的家。

countries.sense: 国家、国度；乡村、乡下（country 的复数）
examples: Now, fifty percent of the world's cocoa(可可) beans come from two countries in West Africa: Côte d'Ivoire and Ghana. 现在全球一半可可豆出自西非两国——科特迪瓦和加纳。

crisis.sense: 危机、危急关头、紧要关头（复数 crises；in crisis 处于危机中）

Climate change affects crops. 气候变化影响农作物。

more.confusables: crop（农作物）/ corps（军团）

examples: The death of the high street is often predicted. 人们常预言商业街的衰亡。

more.confusables: death（死亡）/ dead（死的）/ die（死，动词）

more.confusables: decisions / decision（同族不同词形，注意词性与用法）

due.sense: 预期的、到期的；（due to）由于

more.confusables: due to（由于，介词短语）/ because of（同义）/ be due to do（预计做）

more.confusables: emotional / emotions（同族不同词形，注意词性与用法）

more.confusables: experience（经验，不可数）/ experiences（经历，可数）

experiment.sense: 实验、试验；尝试、实践（do/conduct an experiment 做实验；experiment with 试用）

more.confusables: facts / fact / factors（同族不同词形，注意词性与用法）

faith.sense: 信任、信心、信念；宗教信仰（have faith in 信任；lose faith 失去信心）

more.confusables: global（全球的）/ worldwide（世界范围的）/ globe（地球）
